publicPolicy.description: User access policy: any user may access the space.

memberListPolicy.description: User access policy: only users on the space's member list may access it.

managingAppPolicy.description: User access policy: the managing app is asked, via checkUserAccess, whether to authorize each user.

managingApp.description: Service identifier of the managing app: a DID with an optional service fragment (e.g. 'did:web:example.com#forum').

open.description: App access policy: any app may access the space. No client attestation required.

allowList.description: App access policy: only the named clients may access the space, evaluated against the attested client_id.

allowed.description: The OAuth client IDs permitted to access the space.
